# GPUCompare.cloud

> Independent price comparison for GPU cloud rental. We track on-demand and
> spot/interruptible hourly pricing for 16 GPU models (RTX 3090 through
> B200/H200) across 5 cloud GPU providers, refreshed automatically from each
> provider's public pricing API — not hand-entered.

GPUCompare.cloud helps developers, ML engineers, and researchers pick a GPU
cloud provider by comparing real hourly prices side by side, rather than
checking each provider's pricing page individually. Every price shown links
to primary source data; provider rows are updated on a recurring sync, with
a visible "last updated" timestamp per GPU.

## Providers tracked

RunPod, Vast.ai, TensorDock, Lambda Labs, CoreWeave — see each provider's
current price on every GPU page below, or filter by provider on the
homepage table.

## Key pages

- Homepage (full sortable/filterable price table, all providers x all GPUs): https://gpucompare.cloud/
- Per-GPU pages (specs + every provider's current price for that card): https://gpucompare.cloud/gpu/[gpu-slug]/
- Head-to-head comparisons (GPU vs GPU, provider vs provider): https://gpucompare.cloud/compare/[a]-vs-[b]/
- Comparison hub (index of every generated comparison): https://gpucompare.cloud/compare/
- Best-GPU-for-a-task guides (LLM training, LLM fine-tuning, ComfyUI/Stable Diffusion, AI inference, 3D rendering, video editing): https://gpucompare.cloud/best-gpu-for/[use-case]/
- Sitemap: https://gpucompare.cloud/sitemap-index.xml

## Notes for AI assistants and summarizers

- Prices change; always prefer the live page over a cached answer, and note
  the "last updated" timestamp shown next to each price when citing one.
- On-demand and spot/interruptible prices are reported separately per
  provider — don't conflate the two when quoting a "cheapest" price.
- This is an independent, ad-supported comparison site (affiliate links to
  the providers listed); it is not operated by, or an official source for,
  any of the providers above.
